comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Awarded to those who complete the 4th chapter of Admiral Nelson's storyline. Guide:

Chapter 1 "Whereabouts of the Dark Clouds"
London → Alexandria → Istanbul → Naples → Alexandria (battle here) Supported by
enemy ship Bruys (Dauphin Royal) and French Navy (ship of the line) x 5
Nelson's fleet (Vanguard and ship of the line)

Chapter 2 "Forcing the Cold Region"
London → (60 days required) London → Copenhagen (battles with Fischer fleet twice at sea)
1st battle: Nordic Galleon x 1, Baltic Galleon x 5
2nd battle: Nordic Galleon x1, Baltic Galleon x3,
both supported by Nelson's fleet (first class ship of the line, ship of the line, heavy frigate)

Chapter 3 "The Last Death Battle"
There is information that Naples will enter the Ligurian Sea on the way to Marseille
→ (60 days required?) San Juan
→ (60 days required?) London → Enemy Villeneuve's
fleet in the Strait of Gibraltar (
Soleil Royale x 1, First Class Ship of the Line x 5)
Supported by Nelson Fleet (new Victory, etc.)

Chapter 4 “Return of the Hero”
Ends with a trip to London

Completion also awards a +1 to [Penetration max skill as well (r25 -> r26). Please keep in mind, you cannot complete more than one chapter per real life day. Cheers.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?TheLivesOfHeros%2FHoratioNelson

comments.author: Gudebuddha
comments.body:
At Chapter 1, i had to enter Alexandria a second time for the Nelson story to move forward, i think at the first time the legacy clue in Alexandria blocked it.

Also in Chapter 1, from Istanbul to Naples you encounter a "Storm" wich can be a bit of a problem if one uses autonav to get to Naples and sails with alts. The ships didn't move quickly in that storm because all 3 had a story textbox activated, but they did move in different directions, so be aware.
